question: Why is the accomplished mother-of-letters praised as spanning from cosmos to shell?
premises: The verse praises the accomplished mother-of-letters.
Its scope reaches from cosmos to shell.
Praise implies reverence for that power.
inference: The mother-of-letters is revered as all-pervading accomplished power.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of shell remains unspecified.
plain_english: I praise the accomplished mother-of-letters, whose reach extends from the cosmos to the shell.
